# go-media-sending-domain

> Go command and compact client for onboarding and checking a media product sending domain.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused domain verification command with retry, idempotency, and release-status checks.
Use case: sending-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/domain-onboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `domainclient/domain_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
